parentConsent.title: A learner asked for your consent
parentConsent.requested: Asked on {date}. This request closes on {expires}.

parentConsent.what2: Subjects, target marks and exam dates
parentConsent.what3: Study days, study times, goals and career interests
parentConsent.notCollected: We never ask for a surname, ID number, address, phone number, gender or race.
parentConsent.why: To build a study plan, count down to exams and show progress. The law requires your consent because your child is under 18.

parentConsent.declineBody: We close the request and delete your contact details.
